title: Libraries' Courtyard at Hadrian's Villa
description: The Libraries' Courtyard dates to the Republican period and is one of the oldest gardens at Hadrian's Villa. It is enclosed by a large peristyle, 48 meters wide and 72 meters long. It is located at the northern end of the villa.
